confirmed.title: Web till crashes ('Client error … reading filter') after every 'Ring up and send to kitchen'; the order is fired but the cashier loses the screen
confirmed.repro: Cashier (code login) or foh_management: /pos/shift, open the shift with float 5000, then /pos. confirmed.expected: After ring-up the modal moves to step 2 (take payment) for the new order.
confirmed.actual: The whole page is replaced by the error boundary 'Client error TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'filter')' (console: 'Dashboard error boundary caught …'). The order is already created and sent to the kitchen (status received, on Expo 'Awaiting fire'), and the cart has been cleared. Reproduced 5 of 5 times (cashier desktop x2, foh_management desktop, cashier phone, cashier card). Only workaround: reload /pos, then Open tickets, then find the ticket. confirmed.evidence: shots/pos-cashier-d-6-Charge_ring_up_server_priced_.png; flow-pos-cashier-d.json console; API probe output 'POST /pos/orders 201 keys: [...,'items'] NO payments field'; orphan tickets f0afa371, d7287017, 8c08f71a in DB; close 409 OPEN_TICKETS (flow-close-foh_management). All under /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-servd/33ef43a5-b49c-56f9-95d2-440e3a7d20b8/scratchpad/audit/ui-r2/
confirmed.suspectedCause: frontend/admin/src/components/pos/PaymentModal.tsx:103-113 calls setOrder(r) with the ring-up response, then storedQuote(order) runs, which calls paidCentsOf, which reads order.payments.filter (frontend/admin/src/components/pos/tillApi.ts:126-129). backend/src/modules/pos/service.ts:314-317 (and the idempotent replay at :153) return the order with include { items } only, so 'payments' is undefined. TillOrder (tillApi.ts:65) declares payments as required.
confirmed.suggestedFix: Return payments from createPosOrder (include: { items: { include: { modifiers: true } }, payments: { select: { id, method, amountCents, status } } } in both return paths), and make paidCentsOf tolerate a missing array ((order.payments ?? [])). Add a test that ring-up followed by payment works in the admin till.

verdict.reason: The finding is real. None of the intended changes explain it, and the setup was not at fault: cashier, foh_management, cash and card all fail the same way. backend/src/modules/pos/service.ts createPosOrder returns the order with only `include: { items: { include: { modifiers: true } } }`. That is true for both the fresh path (around line 314) and the idempotent-replay path (around line 153), so the 201 body has no `payments` key. In frontend/admin/src/components/pos/PaymentModal.tsx, ring-up's onSuccess calls clearCart() and then setOrder(r). The next render runs `const stored = order ? storedQuote(order) : null` (line 113). That calls paidCentsOf, which reads `order.payments.filter` (tillApi.ts:126-129), and it throws TypeError. TillOrder declares `payments` as required, but api.post only casts the JSON, so the type checker cannot catch the gap. The throw happens during render, and the only error boundary is the root frontend/admin/src/app/error.tsx, so the whole page is replaced, as the finding says. By then the order is already created with status 'received' (fired to the kitchen) and the cart is cleared. This is a regression from the uncommitted till-UI wave: the committed (HEAD) PaymentModal.tsx has no storedQuote/paidCentsOf. The backend's own step-2 calls work (GET /pos/orders/:id/quote returns 200), so the fault is only the missing field crossing the API contract. The suggested fix is right: include `payments` in both createPosOrder return paths, and make paidCentsOf tolerate a missing array. Severity stays blocker: every ring-up through the web till's main Charge flow crashes 100% of the time. Each one leaves an unpaid fired ticket that blocks shift close, and a cashier who rings again sends a duplicate ticket to the kitchen. The only workaround is reload, then Open tickets.
verdict.evidence:
The verifier is /home/user/servd/backend/.sim/ui-r2/verify/zzverify_ui_0.test.ts. I ran it as a temporary copy at tests/zzverify_ui_0.test.ts, then deleted the copy. It used DB servd_test_rv_ui_0 and a private redis-server on port 6426, db 26 (since shut down). All 6 tests passed. Results:
(1) POST /pos/orders, run as cashier/cash, cashier/card and foh_management/cash, with Nihari plus an 'Extra cheese' modifier, paymentMethod and idempotencyKey set. Each returned 201 with keys "arrivedAt,…,id,…,items,…,walletAmountCents" and no 'payments' key. The DB rows have status 'received', totalCents 184000 (cash) or 172800 (card), and shiftId set.
(2) The test fed each 201 body to the REAL admin storedQuote() from frontend/admin/src/components/pos/tillApi.ts, with only lib/api mocked. Every time it threw "TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'filter')". The same object with `payments: []` gave dueCents equal to totalCents.
(3) An idempotent replay with the same key returned the same order id, also without 'payments', and storedQuote threw the same error.
(4) GET /pos/orders/:id/quote returned 200 {dueCents:184000, paidCents:0}. Company B's cashier got 404 on A's order.
(5) POST /pos/shifts/:id/close returned 409 OPEN_TICKETS ("3 unpaid ticket(s) worth PKR 5408…").
Code: service.ts createPosOrder (around lines 150-153 and 314-317) includes only `items`. PaymentModal.tsx:103-113 does setOrder(r), then storedQuote(order). tillApi.ts:65 declares payments as required, and :126-129 calls order.payments.filter. `git show HEAD:frontend/admin/src/components/pos/PaymentModal.tsx` has no storedQuote, so this is a working-tree regression. The only error boundary is frontend/admin/src/app/error.tsx.

confirmed.title: Procurement role cannot receive deliveries: Receiving page (the one receiving path) is managers-only
confirmed.repro: Sign in as procurement (procurement.a.audit@gsfoods.pk). Sidebar: Procurement, then Receiving (/procurement/receiving). API: GET /api/v1/crosschecks/receiving, /receiving/open-pos and /receiving/suppliers, and POST /crosschecks/receiving, all with the procurement token.
confirmed.expected: The buyer who holds the 'procurement' module can see open POs and log a GRN (CLAUDE.md: procurement = 'supplier chat, POs, inventory receipt'; moduleCatalog calls this 'one receiving path').
confirmed.actual: Page loads empty with three red toasts "Role 'procurement' is not allowed for this resource". GET returns 403 for procurement and 200 for management. POST returns 403. /permissions/me for procurement = ['procurement','inventory','reports'].
confirmed.evidence: crawl-procurement-d.log (/procurement/receiving: 403 /crosschecks/receiving/open-pos, /suppliers, /receiving); procapi output: '/crosschecks/receiving procurement 403 management 200', 'POST receiving as procurement 403'
confirmed.suspectedCause: backend/src/modules/crosschecks/routes.ts:43,54,65,77 use requireAuth(...MANAGERS), while backend/src/lib/moduleAccess.ts:146 gives procurement the procurement module that links /procurement/receiving (frontend/admin/src/lib/moduleCatalog.ts:105).
confirmed.suggestedFix: Allow the procurement role (or the procurement module holders via requireModule) on the receiving GET/POST routes, scoped to the active company. Add a two-company test.

verdict.reason:
The finding's main claim and its suggested fix are wrong. The buyer being refused POST /crosschecks/receiving is intended under owner decision 27 (2026-09-27): "only manager tiers may receive (MANAGERS)", and whoever raised a PO cannot receive it (CEO exempt). This is written down in four places:
- `backend/src/modules/procurement/receiving.ts` (header)
- `backend/src/modules/crosschecks/routes.ts:22-28` ("Manager tiers only (owner decision 27) and deliberately not behind the procurement module")
- `frontend/admin/src/app/procurement/receiving/page.tsx` (header comment)
- `backend/tests/receiving.test.ts:216`, which asserts that non-managers get 403

The PO receive route, POST /procurement/purchase-orders/:id/receive, is MANAGERS-only too. This is separation of duties: the buyer raises the PO and someone else takes the goods in. So "allow procurement on the receiving POST" must not be done.

A smaller defect is real and survives:
- The admin shows the buyer a page that cannot work for them. The procurement module lists "Receiving" (`/procurement/receiving`, `moduleCatalog.ts:105`). `canOpenPath` lets the procurement role open it. The Procurement page shows a "Receive" action on sent/partial POs, with no role check (`procurement/page.tsx:408-409`), and that action leads to the same page.
- Even the READ endpoints the page calls (GET /crosschecks/receiving, /receiving/open-pos, /receiving/suppliers) return 403. So the page loads empty with three red toasts.
- This breaks the wave-3 contract in CLAUDE.md: "A role whose modules include M can use M's pages (every read 200 …)" / "the sidebar and the server agree".
- The role copy is also stale against decision 27: `appRoles.ts:60` says "Supplier chat, POs, inventory receipt" and `workforce/page.tsx:112` says "inventory receiving".

Why low:
- No data leak and no money effect. The server correctly enforces the owner's rule.
- The buyer is simply shown a dead link and button.

The right fix is one of these, not opening receiving to the buyer:
- hide the Receiving sub-link and the "Receive" action from non-manager roles and fix the role blurbs, or
- open only the GETs to PROCUREMENT_TEAM (read-only dock view, company-scoped), keeping POST at MANAGERS.
verdict.evidence:
Reproduced with `/home/user/servd/backend/.sim/ui-r2/verify/zzverify_ui_1.test.ts`. It ran temporarily from `tests/` against DB servd_test_rv_ui_1 and Redis db 13; db 27 does not exist because this server has 16 dbs. The test file was moved out of `tests/` afterwards and the DB dropped. Setup: company A with procurement, management and boh_management users, and a supplier. The buyer raised a PO under the threshold; it was approved and marked sent.

Results:
- `effectiveModulesForUser(procurement)` = [procurement, inventory, reports].
- buyer GET /crosschecks/receiving, /receiving/open-pos, /receiving/suppliers: all 403 "Role 'procurement' is not allowed for this resource".
- management and boh_management: 200 on the same three.
- buyer GET /inventory: 200. buyer GET /procurement/purchase-orders: 200.
- buyer POST /crosschecks/receiving: 403 with a PO, 403 without one.
- buyer POST /procurement/purchase-orders/:id/receive: 403.
- boh_management (not the raiser) POST /crosschecks/receiving: 201.

Code:
- `crosschecks/routes.ts:43,54,65,77` use `requireAuth(...MANAGERS)`, with the comment "Manager tiers only (owner decision 27) and deliberately not behind the procurement module".
- `receiving.ts` header: "Owner decision 27 (2026-09-27): … only manager tiers may receive (MANAGERS); whoever raised the PO cannot receive it".
- `procurement/routes.ts:22`: "MANAGERS: receiving (receiveGoods' own rule)".
- `tests/receiving.test.ts:216-218` asserts a non-manager gets 403.

UI inconsistency:
- `moduleCatalog.ts:105` puts Receiving under the procurement module.
- `canOpenPath` (`moduleCatalog.ts:365`) admits any holder of the module.
- `procurement/page.tsx:408-409` pushes a "Receive" action for sent/partial POs regardless of role, routing to `/procurement/receiving?poId=`.
- `appRoles.ts:60` describes procurement as "Supplier chat, POs, inventory receipt".
- The finding's "CLAUDE.md" quote really comes from `appRoles.ts`; CLAUDE.md does not say it.

confirmed.actual: (a) Red toast "Role 'hr' is not allowed for this resource". The 'Select brand…' dropdown is empty, so the page stays on 'Select a brand to see its rota'. (b) Red toast. The Brand Editor list is empty except '+ Add brand', showing 'Select a brand to edit'. GET /concepts?includeInactive=1 returns 403. PATCH /concepts/:id is MANAGERS-only too, so marketing cannot edit a brand at all.
confirmed.evidence: shots/hr-d/_scheduling.jpg; shots/marketing-d/_marketing_brands.jpg; crawl-hr-d.log, crawl-marketing-d.log, crawl-brand_manager-d.log (403 GET /concepts, /concepts?includeInactive=1)

PATCH /:id at routes.ts:367 is MANAGERS-only.

verdict.reason:
The finding holds. It is not one of the intended changes, and it is not a test-setup mistake. hr holds the 'scheduling' module and marketing/brand_manager hold 'brands', both by default (backend/src/lib/moduleAccess.ts DEFAULT_MODULE_ACCESS, and the HR 'time' and Marketing 'brand' sections in lib/workspaces.ts). The admin page guard canOpenPath lets each of these roles open /scheduling and /marketing/brands.

Both pages build their brand list from plain GET /concepts. In backend/src/modules/concepts/routes.ts, conceptView() (lines ~78-90) gives MANAGERS the 'full' view and CASHIERS the 'till' view, and throws ForbiddenError("Role 'X' is not allowed for this resource") for every other role. The global QueryCache onError in frontend/admin/src/components/ui/Providers.tsx turns that 403 into a red toast, because neither query sets meta.background.

The rest of the backend would serve these users:
- GET /scheduling uses ALL_STAFF, and the scheduling writes use ROTA_PLANNERS, which includes hr. The brand dropdown is the only thing blocking the rota.
- PATCH /concepts/:id is requireAuth(...MANAGERS). That is a role gate, not a module gate, so not even a CEO moduleAllow grant lets marketing or brand_manager edit a brand. Nothing else in the backend writes Concept.description.

This breaks two documented rules in CLAUDE.md:
- Concept.description is to be edited 'in admin → Marketing → Brands'.
- Wave 3: 'a role whose modules include M can use M's pages (every read 200, the workspace's normal writes work)'.

The routes.ts comment by STOREFRONT_CONCEPT_SELECT shows the authors knew the Brand Editor needs the full row, but no view was ever given to the holders of the 'brands' module.

Severity: (b) has no workaround for marketing or brand_manager; only a manager or the CEO can edit brand copy. (a) has a hidden partial workaround. The Rota page seeds conceptId from the shell brand filter (useBrandFilter, which BrandPicker fills from ?view=picker). So an HR user who first picks a brand in the sidebar and then opens Rota gets a working rota. The in-page dropdown stays empty and the toast still shows. High is kept because a whole workspace page is dead for its owning roles before onboarding. No money, tax or tenant-isolation impact; company separation stays intact (hrB gets 404 on company A's rota).
verdict.evidence:
Reproduced with /home/user/servd/backend/.sim/ui-r2/verify/zzverify_ui_2.test.ts (config vitest.ui2.config.ts in the same folder). It ran against the new DB servd_test_rv_ui_2 and uses the real auth middleware, the concepts and scheduling routes, and the admin canOpenPath. 13/13 assertions confirmed the finding.

Redis db 28 is out of range on this server (16 dbs). The Redis error was logged but changed nothing, because these routes do not use Redis. No tracked file was changed and nothing was placed in tests/.

Results:
- hr GET /concepts -> 403 {"code":"FORBIDDEN","message":"Role 'hr' is not allowed for this resource"}
- hr GET /scheduling?conceptId=<A>&weekStart=2026-10-05 -> 200. The rota works once a brand id is known. hrB on company A's brand -> 404.
- hr GET /concepts?view=picker -> 200, own company only (the suggested fix path works).
- marketing and brand_manager GET /concepts?includeInactive=1 -> 403. GET /concepts/:id -> 403.
- marketing and brand_manager PATCH /concepts/:id {description} -> 403, and the description is unchanged in the DB.
- marketing and brand_manager GET /concepts?view=storefront -> 200, but the narrow row has no description field, so it cannot fill the Brand Editor.
- Controls: a manager reads the full list (200) and PATCHes (200); a cashier gets the till list (200).
- effectiveModulesForUser: hr has scheduling, and marketing/brand_manager have brands. canOpenPath('/scheduling','hr',…) and canOpenPath('/marketing/brands',role,…) are both true.

Front-end callers:
- frontend/admin/src/app/scheduling/page.tsx:48: api.get('/concepts'), queryKey ['concepts'], no meta.background.
- frontend/admin/src/app/marketing/brands/page.tsx:120: api.get('/concepts?includeInactive=1').
- BrandPicker uses its own key ['concepts','brand-picker'], so it does not mask the problem through the cache.

The main lists load (e.g. /complaints?limit=100 and /reviews?limit=100 return 200), but the brand filter is empty ('All Concepts' only).
confirmed.evidence: crawl-finance-d.log, crawl-marketing-d.log, crawl-brand_manager-d.log, crawl-boh-d.log, crawl-procurement-d.log; shots/finance-d/_accounting_food_cost.jpg
confirmed.suspectedCause: api.get('/concepts') in frontend/admin/src/app/finance/projections/page.tsx:107, accounting/food-cost/page.tsx:48, accounting/receivables/page.tsx:51, accounting/fixed-assets/page.tsx:40, complaints/page.tsx:137, reviews/page.tsx:60, plus the menu-engineering page and procurement/monitor (GET /auth/users). Backend conceptView refuses non-manager, non-till roles (backend/src/modules/concepts/routes.ts:87-89).

verdict.reason:
The finding is real. Each page named is in the role's sidebar by default and passes the admin page guard. The page's main reads return 200. But the page also makes a plain GET /concepts call, which only managers and till roles may make (the procurement monitor makes GET /auth/users instead, which only managers and HR may make). For these roles that call returns 403 "Role 'X' is not allowed for this resource". The admin's global error handler (Providers.tsx) turns any 403 into a red toast unless the query is marked meta.background, and none of these queries are. The default retry: 1 setting means the request goes out twice.

This is not one of the intended changes. CLAUDE.md wave 3 says "a role whose modules include M can use M's pages (every read 200…)". The fix already used elsewhere, GET /concepts?view=picker, works for every one of these roles and returns only the caller's own company's brands. It is already in use on /orders, /accounting/menu-engineering, /accounting/recipes, /promos, /discounts and /analytics; these 8 pages were missed. The finding says "seven" but lists 8 pages. The test setup is not the cause either: the test uses the real role defaults, the real requireAuth and module gate, and the real canOpenPath.

Severity stays medium. Most of the impact is a toast and an empty filter, but a few functions really break:
- /finance/projections: the page creates the first scenario only when the brand list is non-empty. A finance user in a company with no scenario yet is stuck on "Creating default scenario…" for good. Where a scenario exists, finance cannot add a brand that is missing from it.
- /accounting/receivables and /accounting/fixed-assets: the optional Brand dropdown is empty, so finance cannot tie an invoice or asset to a brand.
- /procurement/monitor: the staff filter and the supplier editor's assigned-staff dropdown are empty.
- /menu-engineering (boh): no brand names and no brand filter.
- /complaints and /reviews: the filter only shows "All concepts".

Two side notes that are not part of this finding:
- The staff "new complaint" form posts to a route that needs a customer login (POST /complaints).
- The manual-review form gets 400 "orderId required" for every role.
Both forms were already broken before this issue.
verdict.evidence:
Test: /home/user/servd/backend/.sim/ui-r2/verify/zzverify_ui_3.test.ts. Run against servd_test_rv_ui_3, with Redis db 29 on a private redis-server on port 6403, because the shared Redis has only 16 dbs. 18/18 passed. The temporary copy tests/zzverify_ui_3.test.ts has been deleted.

What the test showed, with two companies A and B, A having two brands:
- finance: /projections, /recipes/food-cost, /accounting/receivables and /accounting/fixed-assets all return 200. GET /concepts returns 403 {"code":"FORBIDDEN","message":"Role 'finance' is not allowed for this resource"}.
- marketing and brand_manager: /complaints?limit=100 and /reviews?limit=100 return 200; GET /concepts returns 403.
- boh: /recipes returns 200; GET /concepts returns 403.
- procurement: /procurement/suppliers, /procurement/purchase-orders?limit=200 and /tenants/mine return 200; GET /auth/users returns 403 "Role 'procurement' is not allowed…".
- Page guard: canOpenPath() is true for every role and page pair, using the modules from /permissions/me (projections, accounting, complaints, reviews, recipes, procurement).
- Fix path: GET /concepts?view=picker returns 200 for all 5 roles with exactly A's two brands and never B's.
- Control: management and fnb_manager get 200 from plain /concepts.

Where it happens in the code:
- backend/src/modules/concepts/routes.ts:87-89. conceptView() throws ForbiddenError for roles outside MANAGERS and CASHIERS (MANAGERS and CASHIERS are defined in auth/middleware.ts:233-234).

- Plain calls with no meta: finance/projections/page.tsx:107, accounting/food-cost/page.tsx:48, accounting/receivables/page.tsx:51, accounting/fixed-assets/page.tsx:40, complaints/page.tsx:137, reviews/page.tsx:60, menu-engineering/page.tsx:56, procurement/monitor/page.tsx:84.

- finance/projections/page.tsx:128-136 auto-creates the first scenario only when concepts.length > 0. With no scenario, page.tsx:163 keeps showing "Creating default scenario…".

confirmed.title: Admin Z-report overstates sales with money taken on a cancelled ticket and hides refunds; variance shown without sign
confirmed.repro: The cashier's shift takes cash for a storefront pickup order (POST /pos/payments, 1,725) and rings and sells one till order (1,380 cash). A manager cancels the pickup order on /orders/:id and refunds the 1,725 through the 'Money taken' banner. The cashier closes on /pos/shift counting 6,300.
confirmed.expected: The Z-report screen shows sales of 1,380 for 1 order, a line for refunds or money handed back (1,725), and the variance as 'short PKR 80', so the drawer reconciles on screen.
confirmed.actual: Screen: 'Cash Sales PKR 3,105 … Total Sales PKR 3,105 · Orders 1 · Expected Cash PKR 6,380 · Actual 6,300 · Variance PKR 80'. There is no refund line and no sign on the variance. The API returns voids=172500, refundsCents=172500, cancelledPaid.cashCents=172500, netRevenue=138000 and cashVariance=-8000, but the page does not render them. The ledger is correct: shift.close 1015 Dr 138000 + Dr 172500 / 1110 Cr 172500 / 2030 Cr 18000 / 4004 Cr 120000 / 8010 Dr 8000, balanced; the refund entry is Dr 1110 / Cr 1015 172500.
confirmed.evidence: flow-close-cashier.json; z.mjs output for shift 89c373e4 (cashSales 310500, voids 172500, netRevenue 138000, cashVariance -8000); shots/close-cashier.png
confirmed.suspectedCause: frontend/admin/src/app/pos/shift/page.tsx:168-187 (ZReportView rows use cashSales/totalSales and Math.abs(cashVariance). They omit refundsCents/cashRefundsCents/cancelledPaid/netRevenue). Backend getZReport (backend/src/modules/pos/service.ts:1224-1243) counts cancelled-ticket receipts in cashSales/totalSales.
confirmed.suggestedFix: Show 'Money taken on cancelled tickets' and 'Cash refunds' lines, net sales (netRevenue/netCents), and the variance as 'short'/'over'. Consider excluding cancelledPaid from cashSales in getZReport.

verdict.reason:
The finding holds for the admin /pos/shift Z-report screen. It is not one of the intended changes and not a test-setup mistake. In the F7 fix, ZReportView only shows the cancelled-ticket money through a "Refund due" banner, and that banner appears only while refundDueCents > 0. Once a manager hands the money back, the screen has nothing that explains it. ZReportView has no rows for refunds (refundsCents / cashRefundsCents), net sales (netRevenue / netCents), opening float or cancelledPaid. It also shows the variance as fmtPkrWhole(Math.abs(cashVariance)), red whenever it is not zero, so you cannot tell short from over. A variance inside tolerance (isBalanced=true) is red too.

I rate it lower than reported because it is display-only on one screen that disappears after close. The API, the ledger, /reconciliation and the emailed shift summary are all correct: the last two show opening float, cash refunds and refunds, and a signed variance with tolerance. The same missing refund line also appears for any cash refund paid from the drawer during the shift, not only for cancelled tickets.

Part of the suggested fix is risky. totalSales and cashSales are drawer takings throughout: /reconciliation labels them "Total sales (cash + card)" and its cash breakdown adds up to expected cash. Removing cancelledPaid from cashSales in getZReport would break that breakdown. The fix belongs in the UI: show a refunds line, net sales, the opening float and a signed short/over variance, or relabel "Total Sales" as takings.
verdict.evidence:
Reproduced with /home/user/servd/backend/.sim/ui-r2/verify/zzverify_ui_4.test.ts and config vitest.ui4.config.ts, against DB servd_test_rv_ui_4. Redis db 30 is out of range on this server, but the run did not need it. The test calls the real posRoutes and orderRoutes through Fastify inject and builds the storefront order with ingestOrder.

Steps:
- Cashier opens a drawer with 5,000.
- A storefront pickup of 2 x Wrap (1,725) is paid in cash through POST /pos/payments.
- A till order of 1,380 is rung and paid in cash.
- The cashier tries to cancel the pickup and gets 403 MANAGER_OVERRIDE_REQUIRED (intended).
- The manager cancels it. The Z-report now shows refundDue 172500, so the banner would appear.
- The manager refunds 172500 in cash from the cashier's drawer.
- The cashier closes, counting 630000.

API response: cashSales 310500, totalSales 310500, totalOrders 1, voids/refundsCents/cashRefundsCents 172500, netRevenue/netCents 138000, cancelledPaid {count 1, cash 172500}, refundDueCents 0, expected 638000, actual 630000, cashVariance -8000, isBalanced true, openingFloat 500000.

The screen rows are copied from page.tsx ZReportView, and the test checks that copy against the source. They render as: Cash Sales PKR 3,105 / Total Sales PKR 3,105 / Tax PKR 180 / Orders 1 / Expected Cash PKR 6,380 / Actual Cash PKR 6,300 / Variance PKR 80. No refund-due banner and no open-tickets banner appear. The ZReportView source never mentions refundsCents, cashRefundsCents, netRevenue, netCents, openingFloat or cancelledPaid.cashCents.

Drawer payment rows: cash paid 172500 (pickup), cash paid 138000 (till), cash refunded -172500 (pickup).

Ledger (balanced):
- Refund JE: 1110 Dr 172500 / 1015 Cr 172500.
- Shift close: 1015 Dr 138000, 1015 Dr 172500, 1110 Cr 172500, 8010 Dr 8000, 1015 Cr 8000, 4002 Cr 120000, 2030 Cr 18000.

Correct consumers of the same data: frontend/admin/src/app/reconciliation/page.tsx (lines ~155-215) and backend/src/workers/scheduledReports.ts buildShiftSummaryReport. The faulty screen is frontend/admin/src/app/pos/shift/page.tsx, lines 169-193. Company B's cashier cannot read the Z-report (non-200).
